impact.description: Most brand campaigns still optimize toward proxies like CPM or completion rate. But those don’t reflect what really matters: actions taken by consumers. Our AI decisioning engine works on the sell side - optimizing every impression in real time using EDO’s proprietary search engagement data to drive measurable outcomes:

unique deal ID to activate directly from your DSP
